name: Live A Little
source:
After quitting your nine-to-five, boring office job, you pick up and move to Spooklum, a history-rich town full of monsters!

Meet 12 monsters with their own backstories and reasons for being in Spooklum, befriend them (or romance them if you so please!)

[From [url=https://passionbashin.itch.io/live-a-little]itch.io[/url]]
